title: ReAct Loop with a Scripted Model
learning_objectives: Interleave reasoning, tool actions and observations
Feed tool results and errors back to the model
Stop on a final answer or step limit
hints: After parsing a tool call: `res = registry.dispatch({'tool': p['tool'], 'args': p['args']})`.

failure_feedback.advice: Append the assistant message, then a tool message with json.dumps(result).
Report parse errors to the model as {'ok': False, 'error': ...}.
Stop after max_steps model calls with status 'step_limit'.
Call the model with the transcript including previous observations.
